categories.pancha_mahapurusha: Five great person yogas (Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn)
categories.raja: Kingly/royal yogas for power and authority
categories.nabhas: Sky/pattern yogas based on planetary distribution

pancha_mahapurusha_ruchaka.name: Ruchaka Yoga
pancha_mahapurusha_ruchaka.description: Mars in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exalted (Capricorn). Bestows commander-like qualities, courage, valor, and military success.
effects: Success in military, police, or competitive fields

pancha_mahapurusha_bhadra.name: Bhadra Yoga
pancha_mahapurusha_bhadra.description: Mercury in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own sign (Gemini/Virgo) or exalted (Virgo). Bestows intelligence, eloquence, and commercial success.

pancha_mahapurusha_hamsa.name: Hamsa Yoga
pancha_mahapurusha_hamsa.description: Jupiter in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own sign (Sagittarius/Pisces) or exalted (Cancer). Bestows wisdom, spirituality, and divine grace.
effects: Success in teaching and advisory roles
Fame through spiritual or educational work

pancha_mahapurusha_malavya.name: Malavya Yoga
pancha_mahapurusha_malavya.description: Venus in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own sign (Taurus/Libra) or exalted (Pisces). Bestows beauty, luxury, artistic talents, and romantic success.

pancha_mahapurusha_sasa.name: Sasa Yoga
pancha_mahapurusha_sasa.description: Saturn in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) in own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) or exalted (Libra). Bestows discipline, authority, and success through perseverance.
effects: Success in government or large organizations
Wealth through hard work and persistence
Long life and sound health in later years
Head of village, town, or organization

gaja_kesari_yoga.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
gaja_kesari_yoga.description: Jupiter in kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from Moon. One of the most auspicious yogas bestowing intelligence, fame, and prosperity.

sunapha_yoga.name: Sunapha Yoga
sunapha_yoga.description: Any planet (except Sun, Rahu, Ketu) in 2nd house from Moon. Brings self-earned wealth and intelligence.
effects: Equal to a king in status

anapha_yoga.name: Anapha Yoga
anapha_yoga.description: Any planet (except Sun, Rahu, Ketu) in 12th house from Moon. Brings fame, good health, and oratory skills.

durudhara_yoga.name: Durudhara Yoga
durudhara_yoga.description: Planets (except Sun, Rahu, Ketu) on both sides of Moon (2nd and 12th from Moon). Bestows wealth, fame, and happiness.

kemadruma_yoga.name: Kemadruma Yoga
kemadruma_yoga.description: No planets (except Sun, Rahu, Ketu) in 2nd or 12th from Moon. Can indicate poverty and struggles unless cancelled.
effects: But can be cancelled by other factors

chandra_mangala_yoga.name: Chandra Mangala Yoga
chandra_mangala_yoga.description: Moon and Mars conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings wealth through business and trade, but can cause aggression.

adhi_yoga.name: Adhi Yoga
adhi_yoga.description: Benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in 6th, 7th, and 8th from Moon. Brings leadership, health, and victory over enemies.

shakata_yoga.name: Shakata Yoga
shakata_yoga.description: Jupiter in 6th, 8th, or 12th from Moon (but not in kendra from lagna). Causes fluctuating fortunes like a cart wheel.
effects: Periods of prosperity followed by difficulties
Cancelled if Jupiter in kendra from lagna

amala_yoga.name: Amala Yoga
amala_yoga.description: Benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in 10th from Moon or Lagna. Brings spotless reputation and lasting fame.

vasumati_yoga.name: Vasumati Yoga
vasumati_yoga.description: All benefics in upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11) from Moon. Brings exceptional wealth and prosperity.

vesi_yoga.name: Vesi Yoga
vesi_yoga.description: Planet (except Moon, Rahu, Ketu) in 2nd from Sun. Brings good speech, wealth, and learning.

vosi_yoga.name: Vosi Yoga
vosi_yoga.description: Planet (except Moon, Rahu, Ketu) in 12th from Sun. Brings skills, memory, and charitable nature.

ubhayachari_yoga.name: Ubhayachari Yoga
ubhayachari_yoga.description: Planets (except Moon, Rahu, Ketu) on both sides of Sun (2nd and 12th). Brings royalty, eloquence, and fame.

budha_aditya_yoga.name: Budha Aditya Yoga
budha_aditya_yoga.description: Sun and Mercury conjunction. Brings intelligence, fame, and success in intellectual pursuits.
budha_aditya_yoga.notes: Mercury is often with Sun due to orbital proximity. Strength depends on combustion degree.

raja_yoga_1_4_lords.name: Raja Yoga (1st & 4th Lords)
raja_yoga_1_4_lords.description: 1st lord (lagna lord) and 4th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings happiness, property, and conveyances.

raja_yoga_1_5_lords.name: Raja Yoga (1st & 5th Lords)
raja_yoga_1_5_lords.description: 1st lord and 5th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings intelligence, children, and creative success.

raja_yoga_1_7_lords.name: Raja Yoga (1st & 7th Lords)
raja_yoga_1_7_lords.description: 1st lord and 7th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings success through partnerships and marriage.

raja_yoga_1_9_lords.name: Raja Yoga (1st & 9th Lords)
raja_yoga_1_9_lords.description: 1st lord and 9th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Most powerful raja yoga bringing luck, dharma, and fortune.

raja_yoga_1_10_lords.name: Raja Yoga (1st & 10th Lords)
raja_yoga_1_10_lords.description: 1st lord and 10th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings career success, fame, and authority.

raja_yoga_4_5_lords.name: Raja Yoga (4th & 5th Lords)
raja_yoga_4_5_lords.description: 4th lord and 5th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings education, property, and intelligent children.

raja_yoga_4_9_lords.name: Raja Yoga (4th & 9th Lords)
raja_yoga_4_9_lords.description: 4th lord and 9th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings property, fortune, and parental blessings.

raja_yoga_4_10_lords.name: Raja Yoga (4th & 10th Lords)
raja_yoga_4_10_lords.description: 4th lord and 10th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect (Kendra lords). Brings success, property, and career stability.

raja_yoga_5_9_lords.name: Raja Yoga (5th & 9th Lords)
raja_yoga_5_9_lords.description: 5th lord and 9th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect (Trikona lords). One of the most powerful raja yogas.

raja_yoga_5_10_lords.name: Raja Yoga (5th & 10th Lords)
raja_yoga_5_10_lords.description: 5th lord and 10th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Brings creative success in career.

raja_yoga_9_10_lords.name: Dharma Karmadhipati Yoga
raja_yoga_9_10_lords.description: 9th lord and 10th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. The most powerful raja yoga for worldly success.

lakshmi_yoga.name: Lakshmi Yoga
lakshmi_yoga.description: 9th lord strong in kendra or trikona with lagna lord also strong. Brings wealth like Goddess Lakshmi.

dhana_yoga_2_11.name: Dhana Yoga (2nd & 11th Lords)
dhana_yoga_2_11.description: 2nd lord and 11th lord in conjunction or mutual aspect. Primary wealth yoga.

dhana_yoga_5_9.name: Dhana Yoga (5th & 9th Lords)
dhana_yoga_5_9.description: 5th lord and 9th lord connected with 2nd or 11th house. Brings fortunate wealth.

chandra_yoga_wealth.name: Chandra Yoga
chandra_yoga_wealth.description: Moon in own or exalted sign in kendra. Brings wealth and comfort.

kalanidhi_yoga.name: Kalanidhi Yoga
kalanidhi_yoga.description: Jupiter in 2nd or 5th aspected by or conjunct Mercury and Venus. Brings artistic talents and wealth.

mahalakshmi_yoga.name: Mahalakshmi Yoga
mahalakshmi_yoga.description: Lord of 9th house placed in a kendra, and the lord of that kendra is also strong. Immense prosperity.

nabhas_yuga.name: Yuga Yoga
nabhas_yuga.description: All planets in two kendras. Brings imprisonment, poverty, or dependence (unfavorable nabhas yoga).
effects: But can be modified by benefic aspects

nabhas_gola.name: Gola Yoga
nabhas_gola.description: All planets in one kendra. Creates restrictions but also concentration of energy.

nabhas_shula.name: Shula Yoga
nabhas_shula.description: All planets in three consecutive houses. Creates sharpness but also difficulties.

nabhas_kedara.name: Kedara Yoga
nabhas_kedara.description: All planets in four consecutive houses. Agricultural wealth, steady progress.

nabhas_pasha.name: Pasha Yoga
nabhas_pasha.description: All planets in five consecutive houses. Creates bondage and limitations.

nabhas_danda.name: Danda Yoga
nabhas_danda.description: All planets in six consecutive houses. Creates authority but also punishment themes.

nabhas_nauka.name: Nauka Yoga
nabhas_nauka.description: All planets in seven consecutive houses starting from lagna. Brings fame through water/shipping.

nabhas_kuta.name: Kuta Yoga
nabhas_kuta.description: All planets in seven consecutive houses starting from 4th. Deceptive or fortress-like nature.

nabhas_chhatra.name: Chhatra Yoga
nabhas_chhatra.description: All planets in seven consecutive houses starting from 7th. Royal umbrella - brings protection and authority.

nabhas_chapa.name: Chapa Yoga
nabhas_chapa.description: All planets in seven consecutive houses starting from 10th. Bow-shaped - brings valor and hunting skills.

nabhas_ardha_chandra.name: Ardha Chandra Yoga
nabhas_ardha_chandra.description: All planets in seven consecutive houses (any starting point). Half-moon shape brings leadership.

nabhas_chakra.name: Chakra Yoga
nabhas_chakra.description: All planets in alternate houses (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 or 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12). Emperor yoga.

nabhas_samudra.name: Samudra Yoga
nabhas_samudra.description: All planets in all even or all odd houses. Ocean of wealth and pleasures.

parivartana_1_2.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-2nd)
parivartana_1_2.description: 1st and 2nd house lords exchange signs. Brings wealth through self-effort.

parivartana_1_4.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-4th)
parivartana_1_4.description: 1st and 4th house lords exchange signs. Brings property and domestic happiness.

parivartana_1_5.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-5th)
parivartana_1_5.description: 1st and 5th house lords exchange signs. Brings intelligence and good children.

parivartana_1_7.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-7th)
parivartana_1_7.description: 1st and 7th house lords exchange signs. Strong marriage and partnership yoga.

parivartana_1_9.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-9th)
parivartana_1_9.description: 1st and 9th house lords exchange signs. Most auspicious parivartana for fortune.

parivartana_1_10.name: Parivartana Yoga (1st-10th)
parivartana_1_10.description: 1st and 10th house lords exchange signs. Career success and fame.

parivartana_2_11.name: Parivartana Yoga (2nd-11th)
parivartana_2_11.description: 2nd and 11th house lords exchange signs. Powerful wealth yoga.

parivartana_5_9.name: Parivartana Yoga (5th-9th)
parivartana_5_9.description: 5th and 9th house lords exchange signs. Trikona parivartana - extremely auspicious.

parivartana_9_10.name: Parivartana Yoga (9th-10th)
parivartana_9_10.description: 9th and 10th house lords exchange signs. Dharma-Karma parivartana - career aligned with dharma.

dainya_parivartana.name: Dainya Parivartana Yoga
dainya_parivartana.description: Exchange involving 6th, 8th, or 12th lord with other house lord. Creates struggles.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_1.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (Lord Conjunction)
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_1.description: Debilitated planet conjunct with its exaltation sign lord. Cancels debilitation and gives raja yoga.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_2.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (Exaltation Lord Kendra)
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_2.description: Debilitated planet's exaltation sign lord in kendra from Moon or Lagna. Cancellation.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_3.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (Debilitation Lord Strong)
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_3.description: Debilitated planet's debilitation sign lord is in own or exalted sign. Cancellation.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_4.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (Own Navamsa)
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_4.description: Debilitated planet in own or exalted navamsa. Inner strength cancels outer debilitation.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_5.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga (Retrograde)
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga_5.description: Debilitated planet is retrograde. Retrograde motion cancels debilitation.

viparita_raja_yoga_harsha.name: Harsha Yoga (6th Lord Viparita)
viparita_raja_yoga_harsha.description: 6th lord in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Victory over enemies and good health.

viparita_raja_yoga_sarala.name: Sarala Yoga (8th Lord Viparita)
viparita_raja_yoga_sarala.description: 8th lord in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Long life and freedom from fear.

viparita_raja_yoga_vimala.name: Vimala Yoga (12th Lord Viparita)
viparita_raja_yoga_vimala.description: 12th lord in 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Spiritual success and expenditure control.

pravrajya_yoga_1.name: Pravrajya Yoga (Four Planets)
pravrajya_yoga_1.description: Four or more planets in one house, including 10th lord. Renunciation yoga.

sanyasa_yoga_moon_saturn.name: Sanyasa Yoga (Moon-Saturn)
sanyasa_yoga_moon_saturn.description: Moon aspected only by Saturn and no other planet. Creates detachment.

sanyasa_yoga_kendra.name: Sanyasa Yoga (Kendra Malefics)
sanyasa_yoga_kendra.description: All kendras occupied only by malefic planets. Creates world-weariness.

kahala_yoga.name: Kahala Yoga
kahala_yoga.description: 4th lord and Jupiter in mutual kendras, and lagna lord is strong. Brings courage and boldness.

chamara_yoga.name: Chamara Yoga
chamara_yoga.description: Lagna lord exalted in kendra aspected by Jupiter. Royal yoga bringing honor.

sankha_yoga.name: Sankha Yoga
sankha_yoga.description: 5th and 6th lords in mutual kendras, and lagna lord strong. Brings longevity and happiness.

bheri_yoga.name: Bheri Yoga
bheri_yoga.description: All planets in 1st, 2nd, 7th, and 12th houses. Brings fame and wealth.

mridanga_yoga.name: Mridanga Yoga
mridanga_yoga.description: Lagna lord very strong, and all planets in kendras or trikonas. Royal yoga.

pushkala_yoga.name: Pushkala Yoga
pushkala_yoga.description: Moon and lagna lord conjunct, aspected by strong planet, and lagna is vargottama. Great wealth.

shrinatha_yoga.name: Shrinatha Yoga
shrinatha_yoga.description: 7th lord in 10th, 10th lord in 9th, and 9th lord in own/exalted sign. Lord of wealth.

saraswati_yoga.name: Saraswati Yoga
saraswati_yoga.description: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury in kendras, trikonas, or 2nd house. Goddess of learning blesses.

sreenath_yoga.name: Sreenath Yoga
sreenath_yoga.description: Exalted 7th lord in 10th with 9th and 10th lords also strong. Extreme prosperity.

kusuma_yoga.name: Kusuma Yoga
kusuma_yoga.description: Venus in fixed sign in lagna, Moon in angle, and Saturn in 10th. Flower-like prosperity.

matsya_yoga.name: Matsya Yoga
matsya_yoga.description: Malefics in 1st and 9th, benefics in 4th and 8th, and mixed in 5th. Fish-like yoga.

kurma_yoga.name: Kurma Yoga
kurma_yoga.description: Benefics in 5th, 6th, 7th and malefics in 1st, 3rd, 11th. Tortoise yoga - steady success.

khadga_yoga.name: Khadga Yoga
khadga_yoga.description: 9th lord in 2nd, 2nd lord in 9th, and lagna lord in kendra/trikona. Sword-like sharp success.

hari_yoga.name: Hari Yoga
hari_yoga.description: Benefics in 2nd, 8th, 12th from Moon or lagna lord. Blessed by Vishnu.

hara_yoga.name: Hara Yoga
hara_yoga.description: Benefics in 4th, 8th, 9th from Moon or lagna lord. Blessed by Shiva.

brahma_yoga.name: Brahma Yoga
brahma_yoga.description: Jupiter in kendra from 9th lord, Venus in kendra from 11th lord, Mercury in kendra from 1st/10th lord.

vishnu_yoga.name: Vishnu Yoga
vishnu_yoga.description: 9th lord in 10th and 10th lord in 9th (parivartana), both strong. Sustained by Vishnu.

shiva_yoga.name: Shiva Yoga
shiva_yoga.description: 5th lord in 9th, 9th lord in 10th, 10th lord in 5th. Blessed by Shiva.

indra_yoga.name: Indra Yoga
indra_yoga.description: 5th and 11th lords in mutual kendras from Moon. King of gods yoga.

ravi_yoga.name: Ravi Yoga
ravi_yoga.description: Sun in 10th in own or exalted sign, and 10th lord in 3rd house. Sun's brilliance yoga.

garuda_yoga.name: Garuda Yoga
garuda_yoga.description: Moon in 9th exalted, and 9th lord in own sign in kendra/trikona. Eagle yoga.

go_yoga.name: Go Yoga
go_yoga.description: Jupiter in own/exalted sign in lagna and strong. Cow yoga - provider of all needs.

gola_yoga.name: Gola Yoga (Auspicious)
gola_yoga.description: Moon full and bright in lagna aspected by Venus. Ball/sphere of happiness yoga.

arishta_yoga_1.name: Balarishta Yoga (Infant Mortality)
arishta_yoga_1.description: Moon in 6th, 8th, or 12th afflicted by malefics without benefic aspect. Health dangers in childhood.
effects: Can be cancelled by strong Jupiter

arishta_yoga_2.name: Rogakaraka Yoga
arishta_yoga_2.description: 6th lord with lagna lord or in lagna. Prone to diseases.

arishta_yoga_3.name: Bandhana Yoga (Imprisonment)
arishta_yoga_3.description: Lagna lord and 6th lord conjunct with Saturn or Rahu. Danger of imprisonment.

daridra_yoga_1.name: Daridra Yoga (Lords in Dusthana)
daridra_yoga_1.description: 11th lord in 6th, 8th, or 12th and afflicted. Poverty through loss of gains.
effects: Can be mitigated by strong benefics

daridra_yoga_2.name: Daridra Yoga (5th Lord Debilitated)
daridra_yoga_2.description: 5th lord debilitated and afflicted, 5th house also afflicted. Poverty and lack of fortune.
